_meta.what: Per printer: commands this printer's firmware must never be sent, and commands it accepts and silently does nothing with.
_meta.why_public: Kiln's G-code check has to refuse or warn with no record and no connection, on every plan.

fields.refused: a command Kiln will not send or start a file with: `command`, an optional `with` (the parameter letter that makes it harmful), and `why` in one sentence.
fields.ignored: a command the firmware takes without acting on it: `command`, `why` in one sentence, and an optional `instead`.

_meta.rule: Keys are catalogue printer ids. A printer with no row has no rule; nothing here is carried to a sibling model.

refused.why: M2003 P stops this printer's firmware from responding until it is switched off and on again

ignored.why: This printer's firmware does not act on M601, so a print carries on where a pause was meant
